name: Baber Arjumand
headline: Software Engineer | Frontend Lead | Full-Stack Developer
tagline: Software Engineer & Frontend Lead — React · TypeScript · Node.js

summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and frontend lead with over 6 years shipping production web and mobile products in React, TypeScript, and Node.js.

bullets: Architected a B2B cross-border payment platform from concept to alpha in React and Tailwind CSS, delivering the full prototype within an 8-month engagement.
Engineered Node.js, Express, and MongoDB services with Python microservices for financial data analysis and reporting.
Integrated Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions and shipped a global dashboard giving multinational administrators real-time multi-branch liquidity visibility.
Delivered features for an AI conversational commerce platform in React, powering campaigns across 3 channels: WhatsApp, Messenger, and Discord.
Engineered distributed Go and PostgreSQL services on AWS to sustain high-concurrency messaging workflows.
Migrated the unified customer inbox from Redux to Jotai, cutting state-management complexity.
Directed frontend architecture for a Web3 social platform aggregating and verifying cross-chain digital assets and NFTs, leading a distributed engineering team.
Migrated the legacy Angular codebase to React and Next.js, improving load performance, SEO, and scalability.
Engineered a proprietary multi-wallet authentication solution ahead of WalletConnect, plus scrapers backing a searchable NFT database.
Directed 4 technical functions — web engineering, UI/UX, IT infrastructure, and digital marketing — across a concurrent client portfolio.
Supervised offshore teams building React, Angular, and Node.js products, owning budgets, QA, and technical hiring.

items.role: Chief Technology Officer, then Full Stack Engineer
bullets: Led engineering through the full SDLC with hands-on review, testing standards, and CI/CD on AWS, Heroku, and Firebase.
Shipped Ionic apps to the Apple and Google stores with in-app subscriptions and Stripe payment integrations.
Architected an Angular frontend and Spring Boot backend on AWS EC2, integrating Stripe Connect to power a vendor marketplace.
